Well, I went and bought a Glock 19 today....

Uploaded to Imgur because Slimgur and dumb and 'Viewur' or whatever Voat created I can't figure out how to use.

Anyhow, no real story to share. Was sort of on a whim even though I paid too much. My local gun shop is closed for a week as the owners on vacation. Went out of town but nearby to pick this up brand new from a old gun shop. Owners been running it for 3 decades now. Good people. Was going to haggle on price a bit but I felt they deserved my money.

I don't really need any more guns, let alone pistols, but for some reason I've never owned a Glock. Back when I got my carry license a couple years ago a police officer let me hold his Glock (I asked what they carry on the force, he unholstered his gun and made it safe and handed it to me) and loved the grip on them. I like how the grip angle seems to be a bit more profound than other pistols.

Anyhow, taking it out to the range tomorrow and will put a couple hundo rounds through it. Will probably eventually replace my CM9 as my daily carry piece. Will carry the CM9 when wearing more form fitting clothing or needing to really conceal. Will probably carry my G19 under other and normal circumstance. (I don't have a IWB holster for it yet, but it works well in my Galco Kingtuck that is designed for a Sig P-something-or-another. Will get proper IWB hoslter soon)

I rarely OC but have a Serpa paddle holster for it as well which I really like. I just wish it held it a bit closer to the body but I love the finger detatch on it.

Anyhow, it's a Glock. If you've seen one, you've seen them all. Ugly gun, but it'll probably outlive me.
